lines.t: In the stillness of the morning, the whisper filled my soul
Your light breaks through the shadows, and broken hearts are whole
You wore the crown of sorrows, yet peace was in your eyes
A promise softly spoken, beneath the waking sky
The earth stands still in wonder
The heavens call your name
From silence, blue salvation
Eternal love remains
Yahushua, my redeemer
Your love restores my flame
You breathe light through my spirit
I'll never be the same
From darkness into glory
You carry me anew
Forever I'll remember
Remember the love that flows from you
Your truth unfolds like sunrise
Your mercy like the rain
You heal the hearts forgotten
Redeem the deepest pain
Through every storm and struggle
Your voice is calm and true
The lamb once slain is risen
The life that breaks through gloom
Creation sings your triumph
The oceans praise your might
Your kingdom ever shining, the darkness turns to light
Yahushua, my redeemer, your love restores my flame
You breathe life through my spirit, I'll never be the same
From darkness into glory, you carried me anew
Forever I'll remember the love that flows from you
When the storms are raging, I will not be afraid
Your hands reach through the tempest, your promise will not fade
You lift me into freedom, where endless truth abides
The King who reigns forever, with mercy as His God
Yahushua, my Redeemer, the faithful, pure and true
You've ripped in love eternal
In hearts made new by you
All glory to the highest
Forever I'll pursue
The endless grace and wonder
The light that flows from you
The light that flows from you
Thank you.
